title: Sunscreen SPF50

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes are scheduled for the target week. The baseline already reflects recent seasonal trends, including the Memorial Day and Independence Day spikes. The back-to-school season effect in prior years was noise-adjusted to x1.0. Past promotions show no persistent uplift after the week, and the classical model’s suggestion of x1.0 is well-supported. No drivers justify a multiplier deviation.
